segs.t: If you guys cannot step away from your business for one week and everything will just come crashing down,
you don't have a business, you got a job. First get SOPs from every single department in your
business. Afterwards, make sure to hire the right people for those departments such as supply chain
manager, customer service manager, if you're an MR then a retention manager and that is how you're
going to go ahead and delegate your stuff away so that you get more time in your business
so that you can focus on the bigger picture, the things that really move the needle. Afterwards,
what you want to go ahead and do is also for the marketing team, make sure to get creative
strategies, editors and also make sure that you have a lead of media buy that can go ahead and
also coach those creative strategies if they're doing right, if they're doing wrong, keep them
accountable to those KPIs and then that's what's going to really make your business go from here
to here without you being in it. Because if you guys are just focused on getting VA's from the
Philippines which are still good workers, they're not really going to make the big jumps in your
business because it's just a capacity that comes to it. You need A players and A players cost
money and that's the only way you're going to be able to scale.
